nodes: Container for configuring Air Time Fairness (ATF) policies, which manage and allocate wireless airtime among clients to optimize network performance.
Enables or disables Multi-User Multiple Input Multiple Output (MU-MIMO) downlink transmissions for 802.11be (Wi-Fi 7), allowing the access point to send data to multiple clients simultaneously.
Enables or disables Multi-User Multiple Input Multiple Output (MU-MIMO) uplink transmissions for 802.11be (Wi-Fi 7), allowing multiple clients to transmit data to the access point simultaneously.
